    CASTAIC TOWN COUNCIL
    Who We Are
     

    The town council is a non-profit 501c3 volunteer advisory board representing the community of Castaic working alongside the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors and various County Departments such as Public Safety, Regional Planning, and Parks & Recreation. The Castaic Area Town Council is comprised of 10 (ten) elected representatives from 5 (five) regions, within unincorporated Castaic. Elections are held every 2 (two) years, with a 4 (four) year commitment. We address upcoming projects and infrastructure improvements ranging from community concerns to land use, and strategic planning for the Town of Castaic. Safety, Regional Planning, and Parks & Recreation.

    LAND USE MEETING
    September 14, 2026
    Monday at 7:00 PM

    Project:

    ​

    Proposal for 30361 Byfield Rd, Castaic, CA 91384 (APN: 3247-030-057) Los Angeles County Planning (RPPL2026000478 / PRJ2026-000647) 

    The proposed project will involve construction of a grading of 5,456-cubic-yards on slopes greater than 50 percent and within 50 feet of a primary significant ridgeline in the Castaic Area Community Standards District, associated with the construction of a one-story 3,865-square-foot single-family residence with an 857-square-foot attached garage, 236-square-foot front porch, and 991-square-foot attached patio.

    AGENDA
    CASTAIC TOWN COUNCIL
    Committees

    Land Use Committee, Land Use Chair, Abigail DeSesa
    The Land Use Committee does not have regularly scheduled meetings. The Committee meets on an as needed basis. 
    Online Zoom/In Person Location:

    Castaic Union School District Office, 28131 W. Livingston Avenue, Valencia (in the Castaic Commerce Center). 

    Email:  castaictowncouncil@gmail.com​
     

    Parks & Recreation Committee
    The Parks & Recreation Committee serves as a liaison between the community and area Parks & Recreation officials.

    Public Safety Committee 
    The Public Safety Committee serves as a liaison between the community and area public safety officials.  

    Community Standards District
    Castaic is now protected by a Community Standards District (CSD) that provides guidelines and development standards for the Castaic Area, helping us preserve our rural and aesthetic characteristics.
